cases.lookFor: Type the nine lines, then press ✕ (מחיקה) on the first row, «קובייה ABCD». Eight rows stay. In the values panel: «A'(6, 0, 6) או (6/5, 24/5, 6/5)» and «K(2, 4, 2)»; no length of A′C is shown. Ask «A'» in the question box: the answer reads the same two options. The drawing still shows A′ at (6, 0, 6), and «הציגו תצורה אחרת» behaves as before.
cases.before: On prod the panel shows no row for A′ at all (the two places were never both found; it was hidden only because the solver's samples disagreed in the 6th decimal).
